senses.gloss: घ्न a. (f. घ्ना) (used only as the last member of compounds) 1. Killing, destroying, (e.g. राक्षसघ्न); 2. taking away from, (e.g. धर्मघ्न Yaj.i.138); 3. curing, (e.g. वातघ्न).
